environment: Happy DOM, production bundle. DOM behavior verified; no real browser geometry or visual QA.

checks.name: Cabinet renders with Cyrillic and opens the reader
All reading modes preserve the active source and section
A real DOM selection creates an anchored note and highlight
Note edit keeps its source anchor
Category round trip restores the reader and saved position
All themes persist and recolor the complete token system
Reload retains notes, mode, source, section, position and theme
Document contents and comparison source selectors work
Search finds actual user notes and opens the anchored location
Wilkins lives on the workspace and opens a nonmodal conversation
A Wilkins request opens real search with the supplied words
A dictated thought remains a draft with its source until the user saves
Wilkins can be hidden, recalled and configured without losing reading state
A new paper source immediately opens and supports a page-linked note
User text is displayed literally, without executing HTML
Research creation, automatic edits, archive and restore work
Manuscript edits are retained after a fresh mount
Free notes can be saved and reopened from the cabinet
A multi-paragraph selection can be compared and saved with both anchors
Text controls and focus mode update real reading settings
Responsive styles and published production assets remain local
The preserved original standalone backup starts independently
